verdict.rationale: Galileo documents real-time capture of production traces/spans, alerting on unexpected behavior (cost spikes, hallucinations), and Luna models distilled to 'monitor 100% of your traffic' at low cost, confirming continuous evaluator execution on live production data rather than only offline experiments. missing for 10: no independent/third-party case study confirming continuous production monitoring at scale, and no detail on latency/throughput guarantees for real-time evaluator scoring.
